text: Meridian Technologies Inc. v. Apex Global Solutions LLC. Breach of contract and misappropriation of trade secrets arising from failed software licensing agreement. Plaintiff alleges defendant reverse-engineered proprietary algorithms after license termination.

Santos v. Cornerstone Digital Media Inc. Employment discrimination and hostile work environment claim under Title VII. Former Senior Marketing Manager alleges gender-based discrimination in promotion decisions and termination.

Westfield Manufacturing Corp. v. Pacific Supply Chain LLC. Breach of exclusive distribution agreement. Distributor began selling competing products in violation of Section 3.1 exclusivity clause. Estimated damages $2.3M.

Henderson v. GreenLeaf Property Management LLC. Premises liability slip and fall at commercial property. Plaintiff sustained torn rotator cuff requiring surgical repair. Medical specials $62,000 plus $28,000 lost wages.

Atlas Capital Partners LLC acquisition of 200 Commerce Drive, Hartford CT. Commercial real estate purchase of 45,000 sq ft office building for $8.2M. Title clear, Phase I environmental assessment complete, financing approved.

Zenith Pharmaceuticals Inc. v. Nakamura. Trade secret misappropriation under DTSA and state law. Former research director allegedly downloaded 14,000 proprietary compound formulations before departing to competitor.

Rodriguez v. AutoTech Industries Inc. Product liability class action alleging defective airbag deployment sensors in 2021-2023 model vehicles. Class of approximately 340,000 affected vehicle owners. Estimated exposure $180M.

Lakewood Properties LLC v. City of Riverside. Eminent domain challenge to municipal condemnation of 12-acre commercial parcel for public transit hub. Property owner contests $3.2M appraisal, asserting fair market value of $5.8M.

National Medical Devices Alliance antitrust investigation. DOJ Civil Division inquiry into alleged price-fixing among consortium of medical device manufacturers. Client is target of investigation with potential treble damages.

Pinnacle Industries Inc. acquisition of DataStream Corp. Friendly acquisition valued at $420M. Due diligence phase. Key issues include IP portfolio valuation, outstanding litigation liabilities, and regulatory approval under HSR Act.

Blackstone Ventures LP v. Chen. Breach of partnership agreement and fiduciary duty. Limited partner alleges general partner diverted fund assets to personal investments and failed to make required distributions.
Garcia v. Sunbelt Construction Inc. Workers compensation dispute and OSHA retaliation claim. Employee terminated after reporting unsafe scaffolding conditions at downtown high-rise project.

Redwood Financial Group MSA review. Master Services Agreement with NovaTech Software Inc. Contract value $1.8M over 3 years. Key review areas: data security, liability caps, termination rights, IP ownership of customizations.

Thompson Estate v. Metropolitan Hospital System. Medical malpractice wrongful death. Decedent underwent routine appendectomy and expired due to alleged anesthesia error. Estate seeks $4.5M in damages including wrongful death and survival action.

Cascade Holdings LLC commercial lease dispute with Riverfront Retail Partners. Tenant alleges landlord breached quiet enjoyment covenant through prolonged construction activity disrupting business operations for 8 months.
In re: TechVault Data Breach Litigation. Consumer class action following breach exposing 2.1 million customer records including SSN and financial data. Multi-district litigation consolidated in NDCA.

Sullivan & Associates architectural firm formation. New professional corporation formation including operating agreement, professional liability insurance review, and state licensing compliance for multi-state practice.

Delgado v. Prime Logistics Corp. Trucking accident personal injury. 18-wheeler rear-ended client vehicle on I-95. Client sustained cervical disc herniation at C5-C6 and lumbar strain. Medical bills $94,000. Surgery recommended.

Sterling Bank N.A. v. Horizon Development Group. Commercial loan default and foreclosure. Borrower defaulted on $12.5M construction loan. Bank seeks appointment of receiver and foreclosure on partially completed mixed-use development.

Brightpath Education Inc. regulatory compliance matter. DOE investigation into compliance with Title IV federal student aid regulations. Potential liability for improper incentive compensation to admissions staff.

Nguyen v. Pacific Coast Airlines Inc. Passenger injury during severe turbulence event on Flight PCL-447 from LAX to SFO. Client sustained fractured wrist and PTSD diagnosis. Carrier alleges act of God defense.

Oakmont Partners fund restructuring. Private equity fund seeking to convert from Delaware LP to Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership. Tax optimization and investor consent requirements under existing LPA.

Commonwealth v. Rivera. Criminal defense - white collar. Client charged with wire fraud (18 U.S.C. 1343) and money laundering (18 U.S.C. 1956) in connection with alleged cryptocurrency investment scheme. Bail set at $500K.

Barrett Family Trust administration. Decedent's estate valued at $6.8M including real property, investment accounts, and closely-held business interests. Three beneficiaries with competing claims regarding trust amendment validity.

Innovex Biotech patent portfolio prosecution. Filing suite of 5 utility patent applications covering novel CRISPR gene editing delivery mechanisms. Priority date claims through provisional applications filed 2023.

Morrison v. Morrison. High-net-worth divorce proceeding. Marital estate estimated at $14.2M including primary residence, vacation property, stock options, and deferred compensation. Custody dispute over two minor children.

Cedar Rapids Municipal Bond issuance. $45M general obligation bond issuance for school district infrastructure improvements. Bond counsel opinion, disclosure document preparation, and regulatory compliance.

Hartwell Industries environmental remediation. EPA CERCLA enforcement action for contaminated former manufacturing site. PRP group negotiation for cost allocation among 12 potentially responsible parties.

TechForward Inc. Series B financing. Startup raising $28M Series B round led by Sequoia Capital. Negotiation of term sheet, preferred stock purchase agreement, investor rights agreement, and board composition.

Williams v. Metro Transit Authority. 42 U.S.C. 1983 civil rights action alleging excessive force during routine fare inspection. Plaintiff sustained facial fractures and concussion. Body camera footage partially available.

Pacific Rim Trading Co. international arbitration. Dispute under ICC Rules with Chinese manufacturing partner over quality defects in $3.4M shipment of electronic components. Arbitration seated in Singapore.

Clearwater Hospitality Group franchise dispute. Franchisee alleges franchisor failed to provide agreed-upon marketing support and territorial protection. Counterclaim for trademark infringement and franchise fee arrears.

Summit Healthcare Associates physician partnership buyout. Retiring partner's interest valuation disputed. Practice valued between $2.1M and $3.8M depending on methodology. Non-compete and patient transition provisions at issue.

In re: Apex Global Solutions LLC Chapter 11 reorganization. Debtor seeks to reorganize $85M in liabilities. Principal creditors include secured lender ($42M), trade creditors ($28M), and disputed tort claimants ($15M).
Riverside School District special education dispute. Parents seek reimbursement for private school tuition under IDEA after district failed to provide FAPE. Administrative hearing requested.
CrossBorder Logistics Inc. customs and trade compliance audit. Client under CBP audit for misclassification of imported goods under HTS codes. Potential duty underpayment of $1.2M plus penalties.

Digital Arts Collective copyright infringement action against streaming platform. Unauthorized reproduction and distribution of 47 copyrighted visual artworks. Statutory damages sought under 17 U.S.C. 504.

Evergreen Insurance Co. coverage dispute. First-party property claim denied following warehouse fire. Insurer alleges policy exclusion for vacant premises applies. Insured contests vacancy determination.

Heritage Vineyard Estate land use and zoning appeal. Client seeks variance to convert 80-acre agricultural parcel to mixed-use hospitality development. County planning commission denied initial application.

Quantum Computing Research LLC trade secret and non-compete enforcement. Former CTO joined competitor within restricted period. Seek TRO and preliminary injunction to enforce 18-month non-compete and prevent disclosure of proprietary quantum algorithms.
Maple Street Condominium Association v. BuildRight Construction Corp. Construction defect claims in 120-unit residential condominium. Water intrusion affecting 38 units. Estimated repair cost $4.7M.
NorthStar Energy Corp. SEC investigation. Informal inquiry regarding adequacy of climate risk disclosures in annual 10-K filing. Potential violation of Regulation S-K Item 105.
Greenfield Organics FDA regulatory compliance. 510(k) premarket notification for novel food safety testing device. Regulatory strategy and submission preparation for Class II medical device.

Patel v. University Medical Center. ADA discrimination claim. Deaf medical student denied sign language interpreter during clinical rotations. University claims undue hardship defense. DOJ amicus brief filed.

BlueOcean Shipping LLC Jones Act personal injury claim. Merchant mariner injured aboard vessel due to alleged unseaworthy condition of deck equipment. Maintenance and cure claim plus negligence under Jones Act.
Cornerstone Capital Management ERISA fiduciary duty claim. 401(k) plan participants allege excessive fees and imprudent investment options in $200M retirement plan. Class of 4,500 plan participants.

Phoenix Solar LLC project finance and development agreement. $125M solar farm development in Arizona. Negotiate EPC contract, PPA with local utility, and tax equity financing structure with institutional investors.
Estate of Kim v. Ridgeline Ski Resort. Wrongful death action arising from ski lift mechanical failure. Decedent fell 40 feet when chairlift detached from haul rope. CPSC investigation ongoing.

Silverton Mining Corp. mineral rights dispute. Competing claims to subsurface mineral rights on 2,400-acre parcel in Nevada. Historical deed chain analysis reveals ambiguous severance language from 1952 conveyance.

GlobalTech Industries whistleblower retaliation claim. Former compliance officer alleges termination in retaliation for reporting Foreign Corrupt Practices Act violations to audit committee. Seeks reinstatement and back pay under SOX Section 806.
